title: callista sarcantha
intro: Callista sarcantha, commonly known as the Indian coral tree, is a flowering plant in the pea family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its potential to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Callista sarcantha include anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties, which contribute to its use in treating infections and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Callista sarcantha include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
